newsitem.title: UK: Brent crude oil trades lower, spreads hold steady.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude oil trades lower, spreads hold steady.

text.p: Physical Brent values fell after a cargo loading in the first decade of June traded at a 24-cent discount to July paper in line with market expectations that the benchmark North Sea crude was ripe for a fall, traders said.

The June 8-10 cargo trade represented a fall of nearly 30 cents on the last reported Brent trade on Tuesday, when a June 8-10 loader fetched July Brent +3 cents. There was still no word on the fate of Wednesday's three June 12-14 cargoes, two of which were deferred.
One of the cargoes was heard being offered late on Wednesday at July -20 cents.
